blocks.text: Carlos Yulo can finally call himself an Asian Games gold medalist. This after Yulo became the first Filipino gymnast to win a gold in the Asian Games after ruling the floor exercise and vault events in Japan. They were also the first two gold medals for the country in the ongoing continental multi-sport spectacle. Yulo lorded over the men’s floor exercise after scoring 14.666 points. The two-time Olympic champion posted an 8.966 execution score and 5.7 difficulty score to edge Kazakhstan’s Milad Karimi, who also registered 14.600 points for silver.
